event: Weekly Market Review
title: Weekly Market Review
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Small caps led, semis and metals unwound; defensives plus energy absorbed the week.
The tape split hard: IWM +1.96% against a flat-to-down SPY, while SOXX -3.08% and SLV -5.42% gave back gains and QQQ's 20-day slid to -5.39%. Net character was high-to-low rotation with an energy bid, not risk-off. October PMI manufacturing at 56.0 vs 55.5 fc and UMich sentiment 48 vs 46.3 fc framed a resilient-growth week.

INDICES — IWM +1.96% > DIA +0.44% > SPY -0.43% > QQQ -0.76%.
STYLE: small beat large by 2.39pp — a genuine small-over-large week (IJR +1.70%, RSP +1.14%). VIX 19.4, above its 16.5 20-day average and up on the week as VXN hit 28.3 and VVIX 109.7. Biggest cross-asset move: WTI crude +4.32% Friday, USO +14.29% over 20 days. Breadth is thin — only 58% of SPX names above their 50DMA, 56% above the 200DMA.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE +1.60%, XLV +1.45%, XLRE +0.97%, XLU +0.83%, XLB +0.77%, XLP +0.73%, XLF +0.68%, XLY +0.57%, XLK -0.13%, XLI -1.87%, XLC -4.36%.
Top industries CIBR +7.39% and IGV +5.99% won; bottom GDX -8.56% and SILJ -9.78% lost. Money-in: XLV +$1.31bn (100th pctile) and XLE +$640mm (88th); money-out: XLY -$463mm (6th) and XLB -$268mm (4th) — yet SOXX still took +$3.52bn (100th pctile) into a -3% week, classic buy-the-dip. Rotation-state: high-to-low rotation.

DRIVERS — Sourced prints drove the growth-friendly read: October services PMI 57.9 and manufacturing 56.0 both near forecast, UMich final 48.0 vs 46.3, one-year inflation expectations held 4.70%. Semis led the decline, SOXX -3.08% and 20-day -16.50%, while energy (OIH +3.97%, SLB +7.08% on a 5.8% revenue beat) and cybersecurity (PANW +7.22%) drew the flows. Precious metals and crypto-miners bled — GDX -8.56%, WGMI -7.19% — with SLV IV at 39.5%. Note oil's moved partly on geopolitical supply headlines, not macro.

WHAT'S NEXT — The FOMC decision lands Oct 28 with hike odds at 100% per CME FedWatch, so rate-sensitive XLRE and XLU sit at the inflection. Semis drew $3.5bn while falling — watch whether SOXX holds the 20-day -16.50% drawdown or bounces. VIX 19.4 against a 16.5 average and VVIX 109.7 leaves the tape choppy; GLD max pain 368 caps the metals bounce near-term.
